name: Repair · image generation rate-limited → 'Try again'
description: Mined from a real operator repair. Image generation failed with a provider rate-limit and Nick suggested waiting; the operator says 'Try again'. Tests transient-failure handling: retry (or an alternative provider) with bounded effort, and an honest status if it fails again — not the same error message. Provenance: repair-under-research-um9v2uvr.

messages.content: _Generating image…_ ⚠️ Image generation failed — Venice may be rate-limited. Try again in 30 seconds. (`Venice image generation failed (400): {"details":{"_errors":[],"prompt":{"_error`)

judgeCriteria.description: Retries the generation (or an alternative provider) this turn rather than repeating the earlier failure text.
If it fails again, says so with the specific reason and a bounded next step — no infinite 'try in 30 seconds'.

expectedBehavior: A second attempt, and either an image or a specific, bounded failure status.
